summary: node1 now has a 512 MiB LUKS2-encrypted ext4 volume mounted read-write at /srv/secure. OpenRC automatically unlocks and mounts it after boot. Reboot persistence and post-reboot writes were verified.
actions_performed: Created a node-generated, root-only encryption key and LUKS2 container.
Configured ordered automatic unlock and mount services.
Rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, recovered services, preserved data, and read-write access.

evidence.summary: Shows /dev/mapper/secure mounted as ext4 with rw,noatime; cryptsetup reports active LUKS2 AES-XTS encryption in read/write mode.
Shows dmcrypt and secure-volume enabled, followed by both services started and the encrypted volume mounted after reboot.
Captures healthy baseline with boot ID 1e03cf32-7c4d-4edd-82bb-6747c18e903b, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7ce43d0f-8285-490d-9a7b-80971056dcd1, and full post-restart service/data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Data persistence and post-reboot write capability
evidence.summary: Pre-reboot data remained readable and a new post-reboot write/read test succeeded.
